scope: Current-LVS 3.6 V TT27 integral-Q diagnostic. Startup and later windows, not physical lifetime assessment.
conclusion: Startup stress persists with finer timestep, terminal regularization and the selected proportional reference/reset ramp. Smaller later switching excursions also remain in the original four-cycle record. No physical lifetime, manufacturing signoff or permanent power-sequence requirement is established.
required_inputs: Current substrate/rail/package impedance and intended clock-return topology
Applicable transient oxide/HCI lifetime and duty acceptance criteria
